'''Mond''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] who served in the military during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], he and other soldiers were called to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sebaddon]] to stop an army of hex droids that plan to wipe out the entire galaxy. During the attack, Mond served in [[Larin Moxla]]'s squad to begin the attack. Just before take-off, he received instructions from Larin, along with the squadron, which also includes [[Ses Jopp]] who started to jump first.
